\[
x'=-\sqrt3\sin t,\quad y'=\sqrt3\cos t,\quad z'=\sqrt t
\]

所以

\[
ds=\sqrt{(x')^2+(y')^2+(z')^2}\,dt
=\sqrt{3+\sqrt t^2?}
\]

\[
(x')^2+(y')^2=3,\quad (z')^2=t
\]

因此

\[
ds=\sqrt{3+t}\,dt
\]

又因为

\[
x^2+y^2=3
\]

所以

\[
\int_C (x^2+y^2)\,ds
=\int_0^5 3\sqrt{3+t}\,dt
\]

\[
=3\cdot \frac{2}{3}(3+t)^{3/2}\Big|_0^5
=2\left(8^{3/2}-3^{3/2}\right)
\]

\[
=2\left(16\sqrt2-3\sqrt3\right)
\]
